title: FLA import: motionEase tween interpolation not applied — ease value silently ignored
description: Implementation already complete. applyEase() is fully wired: getTweenSpans reads motionEase from keyframes (timeline-query.ts:104), passes it through TweenConfig.ease, and interpolateDisplayObject() calls applyEase(linearT, ease) for every interpolated property. All tests pass including the ease midpoint assertion. The // TODO comment in tween-interp.test.ts:123 was a stale note.
